documentation.content: An agent report did not call every core tool (prefetch should make that impossible). `jsonPayload.missing_core` names them. Likely cause: the report question no longer matches prefetch.STANDARD_QUERY, which silently turns prefetch off.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="gameday-report" AND jsonPayload.event="report" AND jsonPayload.dry_run=false AND jsonPayload.missing_core_n>0
